question: What can two fresh builds accomplish on this one fixed task under equal model, time and feedback conditions?

guidance.scope: Pinned text guidance only; no launcher, detector, hooks or Impeccable model agents; ordinary tools allowed

toolkit.scope: Pinned local skill/reference copies plus isolated compiled CLI/core implementation; no current gallery source or prior evidence

modelPolicy: Use installed codex CLI with identical model/reasoning/service tier in both arms; hash original configuration before every run. The configured gpt-6.1-sol was rejected before task execution in the preserved initial launch. A new predeclared trial uses per-run DESIGN_COMPARISON_MODEL=gpt-6-astra, present in the CLI availability cache, preserving xhigh/default and all other settings. No global config, HOME, CODEX_HOME or auth changes. This is one-model workflow comparison, not a model benchmark.

budget.interpretation: First pass means one fresh uninterrupted builder session; not one source edit.

sharedInputs: Lato Regular/Black and Spectral Regular with OFL licenses
engines: WebKit when executable available; missing engine is unavailable, not pass
actions: download and parse current editable JSON

hardFailures: slider rail drift >1CSSpx during its own drag
metrics.usage: Actual turn.completed usage events from CLI JSONL only. Preserve input, cached-input and output fields separately as supplied. No estimates; missing usage is null. Do not add cached input to input totals.
metrics.latency: Monotonic wall time start through process exit/timeout, including builder self-tests. Setup and evaluator excluded and reported separately.
metrics.qualitative: Blinded complete artifacts: hierarchy, distinct character, readability, task clarity, coherent material/light use, responsive composition. No scalar beauty score. Any synthetic review must remain labeled synthetic; human preference unmeasured until collected.
metrics.performance: Optional measured browser frame samples with hardware/version/method; no general frame-rate, thermal or physical-device claim.

compliance: Immutable common/guidance/toolkit/dependency input hashes before and after; actual JSONL command/read trace screened for forbidden paths/packages/models. This is instruction-and-audit isolation, not OS read-denial. Unknown or suspicious trace requires review before validity claim.
blinding: Random neutral artifact IDs and random sequential run order stored in private mapping before launch. Reviewer index shows IDs only. Source/visible toolkit references can unblind; record that limitation.
limitations: N=1 task and one build per condition cannot establish general superiority or token savings
Different guidance sizes are part of the treatment and measured in actual usage
Guidance-only baseline does not evaluate the full Impeccable runtime
Shared authored direction includes synthetic assumptions, not human preference
Sequential runs can differ in server/cache/load; report actual run order and latency
Browser-port evidence is not physical Safari or iPad hardware evidence

launchAmendment.reason: Initial CLI launch rejected gpt-6.1-sol before any task execution
launchAmendment.outcomeKnownBeforeAmendment: No implementation, usage or rendered comparison outcome existed
